parsedHelp.title: Which messages are recognized?
parsedHelp.intro: Imported messages go through the same parser as live ingestion. A message is staged when it matches one of these templates — compare your export against them to spot anything that would be missed.

hsbc.phoneTransferDebit: Phone Banking Transfer — debit leg (amount ends with -)
hsbc.phoneTransferCredit: Phone Banking Transfer — credit leg (amount ends with +)

bankMisr.atmWithdrawal: ATM cash withdrawal (تم الخصم مبلغ — الة رقم)
bankMisr.cashDeposit: Cash deposit at a machine (تم إضافة مبلغ — الة رقم)

parsedHelp.notTransactions: Credit-card payments and statement/login alerts are detected but never create transactions — card payments open the card reconciliation flow instead.
parsedHelp.otherBanks: The sender identifies the bank automatically, so HSBC and Bank Misr messages can be mixed in one export. Messages from other banks, or templates that changed, are counted as not recognized in the import result so you can spot what is missing.
